1.web: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;
1.asv: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, Consider diligently him that is before thee;

2.web: put a knife to your throat, if you are a man given to appetite.
2.asv: And put a knife to thy throat, If thou be a man given to appetite.

3.web: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.
3.asv: Be not desirous of his dainties; Seeing they are deceitful food.

4.web: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.
4.asv: Weary not thyself to be rich; Cease from thine own wisdom.

5.web: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.
5.asv: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? Forrichescertainly make themselves wings, Like an eagle that flieth toward heaven.

6.web: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies:
6.asv: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, Neither desire thou his dainties:

7.web: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
7.asv: For as he thinketh within himself, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; But his heart is not with thee.

8.web: The morsel which you have eaten you shall vomit up, and lose your good words.
8.asv: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, And lose thy sweet words.

9.web: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
9.asv: Speak not in the hearing of a fool; For he will despise the wisdom of thy words.

10.web: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless:
10.asv: Remove not the ancient landmark; And enter not into the fields of the fatherless:

11.web: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.
11.asv: For their Redeemer is strong; He will plead their cause against thee.

12.web: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.
12.asv: Apply thy heart unto instruction, And thine ears to the words of knowledge.

13.web: Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.
13.asv: Withhold not correction from the child; Forif thou beat him with the rod, he will not die.

14.web: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.
14.asv: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, And shalt deliver his soul from Sheol.

15.web: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine:
15.asv: My son, if thy heart be wise, My heart will be glad, even mine:

16.web: yes, my heart will rejoice, when your lips speak what is right.
16.asv: Yea, my heart will rejoice, When thy lips speak right things.

17.web: Don’t let your heart envy sinners; but rather fear Yahweh all the day long.
17.asv: Let not thy heart envy sinners; Butbe thouin the fear of Jehovah all the day long:

18.web: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.
18.asv: For surely there is a reward; And thy hope shall not be cut off.

19.web: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!
19.asv: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, And guide thy heart in the way.

20.web: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat:
20.asv: Be not among winebibbers, Among gluttonous eaters of flesh:

21.web: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.
21.asv: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty; And drowsiness will clothea manwith rags.

22.web: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.
22.asv: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, And despise not thy mother when she is old.

23.web: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.
23.asv: Buy the truth, and sell it not; Yea, wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.

24.web: The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.
24.asv: The father of the righteous will greatly rejoice; And he that begetteth a wise child will have joy of him.

25.web: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!
25.asv: Let thy father and thy mother be glad, And let her that bare thee rejoice.

26.web: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.
26.asv: My son, give me thy heart; And let thine eyes delight in my ways.

27.web: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.
27.asv: For a harlot is a deep ditch; And a foreign woman is a narrow pit.

28.web: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.
28.asv: Yea, she lieth in wait as a robber, And increaseth the treacherous among men.

29.web: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?
29.asv: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? Who hath complaining? who hath wounds without cause? Who hath redness of eyes?

30.web: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.
30.asv: They that tarry long at the wine; They that go to seek out mixed wine.

31.web: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.
31.asv: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, When it sparkleth in the cup, When it goeth down smoothly:

32.web: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.
32.asv: At the last it biteth like a serpent, And stingeth like an adder.

33.web: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.
33.asv: Thine eyes shall behold strange things, And thy heart shall utter perverse things.

34.web: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the midst of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:
34.asv: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, Or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.

35.web: “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I can find another.”
35.asv: They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not hurt; They have beaten me, and I felt it not: When shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.
